_comment: Tier-2: the OptimizationApplication response utilities want a DoubleCombinedTensorAdaptor built from a DoubleTensorAdaptor over a VariableTensorAdaptor — not a numpy array — and per-element design variables need per-element Properties first. Pitfall (kratos.optimization #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). None of the three adaptor classes is a core KratosMultiphysics attribute, so the natural dotted path fails before any gradient call; KOA.OptimizationUtils and its CreateEntitySpecificPropertiesForContainer — the per-element Properties step the claim requires — do resolve on the application. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX RENUMBERED 2 -> 1: guidance entries were moved out of kratos.optimization's pitfalls list, which shifted the indices of the entries after them. The claim this fixture verifies is unchanged.
